text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm tidying up after finishing training 
with Satono Crown, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. May I continue training for 
just a little longer?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Dia is trying so hard out there. 
...There's no way I can let it end here 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I know. I don't believe that the 
amount of practice alone determines 
superiority."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I just want to convince myself. That I'm 
putting in just as much effort... you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to stand side-by-side and 
compete with your rival?
choice_data_list: That's precisely why you need to rest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to stand side-by-side and 
compete with your rival?
choice_data_list: That's precisely why you need to rest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Since we're here, maybe I'll go 
for a run with Dia!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Training is always welcome! What should we 
do?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Remember what we did right after 
enrolling? That "who can run the longest" 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of them devoted 
themselves to training until they were 
both satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that anything more would be 
overwork, and that now was not the time to 
stand alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...'Not right now,' huh. You're 
definitely right. I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Still... seeing a rival just makes me 
fire right up!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we tidied up and took a proper, 
well-deserved rest.
